text:
QUOTE: The app's network client defaults to 3 retries with exponential backoff (`app/managers/network_manager.ts:68-73`), but `ClientPosts.createPost` passes `noRetry: true` (`app/client/rest/posts.ts:43-47`), which sets `retryLimit: 0`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: States general default of 3 exponential retries set in the network manager, and that createPost opts out via noRetry.
